snippet.title: [NP] PMWC at EWC 26 Finals D2 | PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko Finals jari chha!

PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko ultimate stage Finals ko Day 2 aaja Paris ma suru hudai chha! Dherai dinko fierce competition pachi, world ka top 16 teams le glory, legacy ra $3,000,000 prize pool ko sabai bhanda thulo hissa ko lagi ladna aafno thau secure gareka chan.

Yo nai ho tyo moment jasko lagi harek team le grind gareko thiyo, ra euta din ko battle pahilai sakisakeko chha. Group Stage ka best teams ra Survival Stage bata survive gareka teams aba feri ekpatak barsako sabai bhanda intense showdown ma head-to-head bhidnechan. Tin din, SMASH RULE, ra euta champion.

Journey aaja jhan uchai ma pugchha, kina bhane antim ma trophy uthaera PUBG MOBILE history ma aafno naam lekhaune team keval euta matra hunechha. Finals ko Day 2 suru Vayo!

🔥SMASH RULE kasari kaam garchha?

snippet.title: YaniMaya - Karma Unplugged Chapter 01
snippet.description:
KARMA UNPLUGGED

CHAPTER 01 — Yani Maya

Originally released in 2007, Yani Maya is one of Karma’s memorable songs. Almost two decades later, the song returns in a different form - unplugged, bringing a new texture to a song many have known for years.

FILMED AT — JAYA MANOHAR VIHAR

ललितपुर महानगरपालिका वडा नं. ८ मा रहेको यस इन्द्र देव संस्कारित जय मनोहर महाविहार आज भन्दा लगभग १००० वर्ष अघि स्थापना भएको इतिहास रहेको छ। लिच्छविकालमा भएको भिषण आगलागीमा काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको विशालनगर ध्वस्त भए पश्चात् यो विहार स्थानान्तरण हुँदै हालको स्थानमा स्थापना भएको इतिहास र किम्बदन्तीमा उल्लेख गरेको पाइन्छ। हाल यस विहारको चलन चल्तीको नाम सुबहाल रहेकोछ।

विहार स्थापना हुनु अघि यहाँ मसान रहेको मानिन्छ र यसको अवशेष हाल सम्म विहारको मध्य भागमा रहेको देख्न सकिन्छ।

यस विहारको विशेषता भनेको यहाँ विराजमान महाकाललाई टुँडिखेलको महानवमीको राति दिइने  माछु  ( मान्छेको शरीरको मासु वा छाला) को आहुति दिने परम्परा रहेको छ। उक्त रात वृद्धवृद्धा र आइमाईहरूको उपस्थितिमा आहुति दिन इच्छुक व्यक्तिले विधिवत रूपमा आफ्नो शरीरको मासु / छाला चढाउन सक्ने परम्परा हाल समय यथावत नै रहेको छ।

A heartfelt thank you to the Jaya Manohar Vihar Committee for allowing us to bring this chapter to life at this historic space, and to our production and management teams for making the journey possible.

This is KARMA UNPLUGGED — CHAPTER 01: Yani Maya.

©️ 2026 Karma Band
Managed by ASQ

Vaaroon Forever Lyrics :

Intro Chorus

Bandha nainon ne nainon se dora
Mohe kheenche chala moh tora
Tohe saunpa hai tan mann ye kora
Mohe thaame tu rakhna sada
My gaze is entangled to your gaze
And your love is tugging me towards you
I have surrendered my pristine self to you
Hold on to me forever

Verse 01

Vaaroon, vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Ab na jag ki hai parvaah koi
Thaam le tu mori jindagi
Tohse badh ke na koi khushi
I devote myself to you
No longer do I care for the world
Be the hands that hold my life
There’s no greater joy than you
Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Aaj saunpe hai sapne sabhi
Naina tore tijori mori
Hai mori
I devote myself to you
Today I handover all my dreams to you
Your eyes are my safe place

Chorus 01

Pheeka pheeka tha manwa ye mora
Chhoo ke toone bhara rang tora
Mele jaisa saja hai ye angana
Tohre aane se dil ka mora
My heart was so colourless n dull
Your touch filled it with (your) colours
My heart is adorned like a carnival
Ever since you came into my life

Verse 02

Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Tohse naata hai mora koi
Tu gagan main pawan hoon tori
Mori saansein bhi sab hain tori
I devote myself to you
There is a bond between us
If you are a sky, I am your wind
Every breath of mine is yours
Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Mohe aankho mein bhar le kahin
Tori khushiyon se dharkan mori
Hai mori
I devote myself to you
Let me dwell in your eyes somewhere
Your happiness makes my heart beat

Chorus 02

Tohse janamo ka phera hai mora
Tohri chhaaya mein mora basera
Tohre vaade pe sab kuchh luta doon
Moh pe rakhna bharosa zara
I have belonged to you across lifetimes
I reside in your shade
For your promise, I'd give my all
Have faith in me

Verse 03

Tore naaz saare utha loon, jo kahe
Ye naina more, more jaage hain sung tore
Har raat tori saja doon, jo kahe
Hain jeena mohe, mohe jeena hai sung tore
I’ll fulfil all your whims, if you wish
These eyes will stay awake with you
I’ll light up all your nights, if you wish
I want to live, I want to live beside you forever

Chorus 3

Tore aage main sir ko jhuka doon
Tore sapne palak pe bitha doon
Kaala teeka main tohe laga doon
Tohe laage nazar na zara
I’d bow my head before you,
Hold your dreams gently upon my eyes
Mark you with a little ward against the evil eye
May no ill ever fall upon you

bn.title: ডুমসডে স্পেশাল লুক ট্রেলার রিঅ্যাকশন
bn.description:
#thePJ #PJExplained

আপনি যদি সিনেমা ভালোবাসেন, তাহলে আপনার ঠিকানা হলো মক্টেল (Moctale) — https://www.moctale.in

ইনস্টাগ্রাম: https://www.instagram.com/pjexplained/
ফেসবুক: https://www.facebook.com/pjexplained/
thePJ: https://www.youtube.com/@thepjoffical

টুইটার: https://twitter.com/pjexplained/
হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ: https://shorturl.at/vQxpU
থ্রেডস: https://www.threads.net/@pjexplained
স্ন্যাপচ্যাট: https://www.snapchat.com/add/pjexplained
ব্যবসায়িক ইমেইল: teamthepj@gmail.com

thePJ হলো একটি ওয়েব চ্যানেল, যার উদ্দেশ্য হলো চলচ্চিত্র পর্যালোচনা, সাক্ষাৎকার, আলোচনা, ভিডিও প্রবন্ধ এবং বিশ্লেষণধর্মী সংকলনের মাধ্যমে সিনেমার প্রচার করা। এর প্রধান উদ্দেশ্য হলো চলচ্চিত্র নিয়ে তথ্যসমৃদ্ধ আলোচনা, সমালোচনা এবং পর্যালোচনাকে উৎসাহিত করা এবং এই উদ্দেশ্যে অনুষ্ঠানগুলোতে চলচ্চিত্র, শব্দ রেকর্ডিং এবং আলোকচিত্রের সংক্ষিপ্ত অংশ ব্যবহার করা হয়। এই ক্লিপ এবং অংশগুলো খুবই সীমিত এবং এর ব্যবহার কপিরাইটের মালিকদের দ্বারা সম্পূর্ণ কাজের বাণিজ্যিক ব্যবহারে কোনোভাবেই হস্তক্ষেপ করার উদ্দেশ্যে করা হয় না। এই কাজগুলোর ব্যবহার কপিরাইট আইনের ৫২ ধারার অধীনে প্রদত্ত ন্যায্য ব্যবহারের ব্যতিক্রমের সাথে সঙ্গতিপূর্ণ, এবং আমরা সমালোচনা ও পর্যালোচনার জন্য প্রদত্ত ব্যতিক্রমের অধীনেই এই কাজগুলো ব্যবহারের দাবি করি।

snippet.title: Yabesh Thapa - Tadha ft. Oshin Karki | OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO
snippet.description:
I made Tadha almost four years ago and was obsessed with the idea, but I felt stuck at the same time. I knew I wanted to write a song that justifies loving someone from a distance, because the people we love can't always be by our side. Even though the song is called Tadha and carries a certain sadness, I wanted it to feel warm, fun, and full of love, but I just couldn't figure out how to finish it. It wasn't until I started working on GhaamChhaya that I finally found the motivation to complete it. Oshin graced the song with her beautiful voice, making it even more special. Fast forward a couple of years, we finally got to make a fun video for Tadha, and we hope you guys enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it !

This one is for all the tadha batai maya garne mayalus !

Written, Composed, and Performed by Yabesh Thapa & Oshin Karki
Produced by Yabesh Thapa
Mixed and Mastered by SNJV

Visuals by Noisy

snippet.title: You’re My Beautiful Reason ❤️ | Romantic Love Song Duet | Emotional Love Ballad
snippet.description:
You’re My Beautiful Reason is a deeply emotional romantic duet about finding the one person who makes life feel complete. ❤️

A love that brings color back to your world, gives you strength through every storm, and turns ordinary moments into memories you never want to lose.

✨ “If forever has a meaning, it’s growing old with you…”

This heartfelt male and female duet is for everyone who has found someone they want beside them through every season of life.

Perfect for romantic evenings, weddings, slow dances, anniversaries, couples, love playlists, or simply closing your eyes and thinking about the person who means everything to you.

🎧 Listen with headphones and let the music speak to your heart.

Soft Emotion Music
Music for love, memories, and the moments that stay forever. ❤️

#YoureMyBeautifulReason #LoveSong #RomanticSong #LoveSongDuet #EmotionalLoveSong #RomanticDuet #LoveBallad #WeddingSong #SlowDance #ForeverLove #SoftEmotionMusic

snippet.title: LEGACY EP 10 | THE SOUNDS OF INDIA | @raftaarmusic x @KRSNAOfficial
snippet.description:
The sounds of India take over the stage.

In Episode 10, the artists step onto the stage carrying more than just bars. They bring the sounds, stories and influences of the places they call home.
Each artist has the chance to represent their roots and turn their culture into a performance that is uniquely their own.

From language and local sounds to personal stories and regional identity, this round is about showing where they come from and making sure the audience hears it.
Who will bring their roots to life and leave a lasting mark on the stage?

snippet.title: [MAP] PMWC at EWC 26 Finals D3 | PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Welcome to the PUBG MOBILE World Cup At 2026 Esports World Cup Finals Day 3 Map Feed! 
This stream provides a real-time map-only view, allowing you to track team rotations, zone shifts, and strategic movements as they unfold.

This is it the last matches of PMWC at EWC 26. The world’s best 16 teams have given everything, but only one will lift the trophy and take home the lion’s share of the $3,000,000 prize pool. Every rotation, every zone, and every elimination today could change the outcome of the entire championship because, now a team can win with SMASH RULE.

🔥 How does SMASH RULE work? 
On the last day of the PMWC at EWC 26 Finals, we have the Match Point Threshold! In Overall Ranking after 12th match, #1 ranked team’s points +10. Any team that hits this must then win a later match to claim the trophy winning the same match where they reach the threshold doesn’t bring the championship. If no team secures the title via SMASH Rule by Match 18, the team with the highest total points wins under standard rules.

🔥 Why You Can't Miss PMWC at EWC 26:
- Witness the world's top PUBG MOBILE teams battle for glory in Paris!
- Experience high-stakes action with every match impacting the race.
- Cheer for your favorite region and team as they chase the $3,000,000 and a crown!
- Exciting SMASH RULE format in Finals!

Group Stage: August 6–9
Survival Stage: August 11–12

Nazar Lagi featuring Akanksha Choudhary is a heartbreak ballad by Goldie Sohel and Asees Kaur that captures the silent ache of two hearts deeply in love, yet separated by circumstances beyond their control. It is a story of longing, memories that refuse to fade, and the unbearable pain of watching love slip away despite never wanting to let go.

snippet.title: Sheetal | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Sheetal - a sweet summer love story of “Ritu” and “Mausam”. 

Ritu arrives in a new city and meets Mausam, and they fall into a whirlwind romance that feels like it could last forever. But fate had other plans. When Ritu returns to find him, she is met with the cold truth of Mausam’s passing.

He may have left the world, but the feeling of him—the laughter in the ride, the warmth of his hand, the shade he offered in her hottest moments—refuses to fade. This video is a meditation on how the shortest chapters often leave the deepest imprints. Some loves don't need a lifetime to become eternal; they just need to be real.


Starring : Muskan Gurung, Cheyozen

________________________________________________________________________________
Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko Finals jari chha!

PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko ultimate stage Finals ko Day 2 aaja Paris ma suru hudai chha! Dherai dinko fierce competition pachi, world ka top 16 teams le glory, legacy ra $3,000,000 prize pool ko sabai bhanda thulo hissa ko lagi ladna aafno thau secure gareka chan.

Yo nai ho tyo moment jasko lagi harek team le grind gareko thiyo, ra euta din ko battle pahilai sakisakeko chha. Group Stage ka best teams ra Survival Stage bata survive gareka teams aba feri ekpatak barsako sabai bhanda intense showdown ma head-to-head bhidnechan. Tin din, SMASH RULE, ra euta champion.

Journey aaja jhan uchai ma pugchha, kina bhane antim ma trophy uthaera PUBG MOBILE history ma aafno naam lekhaune team keval euta matra hunechha. Finals ko Day 2 suru Vayo!

🔥SMASH RULE kasari kaam garchha?
Finals ko Day 2 pachi, Match Point Threshold #1 ranked team ko points +10 ma set garincha. Yo threshold reach gareko team le tyaspachi ko kunai match jitnu parchha trophy claim garna. Threshold reach gareko tei match jitda championship jitidaina. Yedi Match 18 samma kunai team le SMASH RULE anusaar title secure garna sakena bhane, standard rules anusaar sabai bhanda dherai total points bhayeko team champion hunechha.

🔥 Kina tapaile PMWC at EWC 26 miss garnu hudaina:

Paris ma world ko top PUBG MOBILE teams haru glory ko lagi battle gareko hernuhos!
Pratyek match le race ma impact parne high-stakes action ko experience garnuhos!
Aafno favorite region ra team lai $3,000,000 ra crown ko lagi cheer garnuhos!
Finals ma exciting SMASH RULE format!

📅 TOURNAMENT SCHEDULE

Group Stage: August 6–9
Survival Stage: August 11–12
Finals: August 14–16

Try PUBG MOBILE now: https://pubgmobile.go.link/26pmwc

💰 Total Prize Pool: $3,000,000
📍 Venue: Qiddiya City Grid, Paris, France

📌This is the moment when someone is gone, yet their presence still lingers in every corner of the room.
It is a song about choosing dignity over longing, accepting the tears without surrendering to them, and reclaiming the right to decide what stays, what is released, and where life goes next. 
Healing does not mean you never bend. It means that, even through the pain, you keep walking until your life belongs to you again.


Evening leaning on the walls
Shadows stretching down the halls
Your keys still waited by the door
For hands that won’t come back once more..

One empty hook beside the frame
The smallest things still keep your name
Some people fit beneath your skin
That doesn't mean you let them in
Don’t mistake my calm for torn,
I know exactly what went wrong

It is, like a promise,  past its date
What to lose,  and what to save 
And I stand here inside this place
Where the silence, wears your face

I won’t beg for what is gone
I don’t feed what will not grow
No more waiting for a sign
I decide this life is mine
Yes, I decide this life is mine. 
I may bend, but I’ll be fine. 

Your number lives inside my phone
Like a road that leads back home
I nearly sent you something small
But it wouldn’t change, a thing at all

I watch the evening change the room
Making space where you once moved
And the silence starts to sound
Like my voice comes back around
Some people settle in your bones
Then leave you colder than alone. 

It is, like a promise,  past its date
What to lose,  and what to save. 
And I stand here inside this place
Where the silence, wears your face

I won’t beg for what is gone
I don’t feed what will not grow
No more waiting for a sign
I decide this life is mine
Yes I decide this life is mine
I may bend, but I’ll be fine

Some goodbyes show you who you are
When you stop hiding every scar
Even if I melt into tears
I’ll keep walking through my fears.

bn.title: GTA 5 লাইভ #gta5 #gtav #গেমিং
bn.description:
চূড়ান্ত GTA V লাইভ স্ট্রিমে আপনাকে স্বাগতম, যেখানে আমরা দ্রুতগতির গাড়ি নিয়ে রেস করি, লস স্যান্টোস ঘুরে দেখি এবং স্বচ্ছন্দ গেমপ্লের সাথে আনন্দ করি। আপনি যদি হাই-স্পিড রেস, সাবলীল ড্রাইভিং এবং আরামদায়ক গেমিং স্ট্রিম পছন্দ করেন, তাহলে আপনি সঠিক জায়গায় এসেছেন। লাইভ চ্যাটে যোগ দিন, রেসের পরামর্শ দিন এবং স্বচ্ছন্দ পরিবেশে অবিরাম GTA 5-এর মজা উপভোগ করুন। এই স্ট্রিমটি মূলত গতি, স্টাইল এবং কমিউনিটির সাথে আড্ডা দেওয়ার জন্য। চ্যানেলকে সমর্থন করতে এবং GTA V পরিবারের অংশ হতে স্ট্রিমটি লাইক, সাবস্ক্রাইব এবং শেয়ার করতে ভুলবেন না। #gta6

► 50,000 ஷார்ட் அணி: மானுவல் நியூயர், ஹாரி கேன், ரோட்ரிகோ, பார்கோலா, அல்போன்சோ டேவிஸ், கஸ்டோ, பிரேமர் மற்றும் எடர் மிலிடாவோ
► 100,000 ஷார்ட் அணி: ஸ்செஸ்னி, மார்செலோ, சிங்கோ, பிரேமர், யில்டிஸ், ஃபேபியன் ரூயிஸ் மற்றும் முழுமையான தாக்குதல் பகுப்பாய்வு
► 500,000 ஷார்ட் அணி: பீட்டர் செக், பிலிப் லாம், கியேலினி, டோனி குரூஸ், பிர்லோ, மகேலேலே, கரேத் பேல் மற்றும் ரொனால்டோ
► எந்த விளையாட்டு பாணிகள் உண்மையில் முக்கியமானவை — ரேபிட், ஆக்சிலரேட்டர், ஆன்டிசிபேட், கார்டியன் மற்றும் டிஃப்ளெக்டர் பாணிகள் விளக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன
► எங்கே அதிகமாக செலவு செய்வது, எங்கே சேமிப்பது — கோல்கீப்பர் இடத்திற்காக ஏன் ஒருபோதும் உங்கள் பட்ஜெட்டை செலவழிக்கக் கூடாது
► ஒவ்வொரு வீரரையும் ஒப்பந்தம் செய்வதற்கு முன்பான முழுமையான புள்ளிவிவர ஒப்பீடுகள்
► இறுதி முடிவுகள்: 10K, 50K, 100K மற்றும் 500K ஷார்ட்கள் மூலம் உண்மையில் எவ்வளவு OVR கிடைக்கும்

அத்தியாயங்கள்

0:00 4 பட்ஜெட் சவால் விளக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது

4:45 10,000 ஷார்ட் முடிவு
5:15 50,000 ஷார்ட் ஸ்குவாட் உருவாக்கம்
11:30 50,000 ஷார்ட் முடிவு
11:58 100,000 ஷார்ட் ஸ்குவாட் உருவாக்கம்
16:22 100,000 ஷார்ட் முடிவு

21:48 இறுதி முடிவுகள் — அனைத்து 4 பட்ஜெட்களின் ஒப்பீடு

EA SPORTS FC Mobile-ல் சாத்தியமான சிறந்த ஸ்குவாட்களை நான் இங்குதான் உருவாக்குகிறேன் — பட்ஜெட் ஸ்குவாட் பில்டர்கள், மலிவான பீஸ்ட் பிக்ஸ், பேக் ஓப்பனிங்ஸ், அப்கிரேடுகள், ரேங்க் அப் வழிகாட்டிகள் மற்றும் ஒவ்வொரு வாரமும் உண்மையான கேம்ப்ளே. உங்கள் ஷார்ட்களைச் செலவழிப்பதற்கு முன், எந்த வீரர்கள் அதற்குத் தகுதியானவர்கள் என்பதைத் துல்லியமாகத் தெரிந்துகொள்ள விரும்பினால், நீங்கள் சரியான இடத்தில்தான் இருக்கிறீர்கள். அடுத்து நான் எந்த பட்ஜெட்டில் உருவாக்க வேண்டும் என்பதை கமெண்ட் செய்யுங்கள். சப்ஸ்கிரைப் செய்து பெல் ஐகானை அழுத்தவும், இதன் மூலம் நீங்கள் எந்த வீடியோவையும் தவறவிட மாட்டீர்கள்.

iw.title: נבחרת של 10,000 שארדים מול 500,000 שארדים ב-FC MOBILE!
iw.description:
📩 פניות עסקיות: rkreddy@digitalsportsmgmt.com

מה מכוסה בסרטון הזה

► בניית 4 סגלים שונים של FC Mobile עם 10,000, 50,000, 100,000 ו-500,000 רסיסי קוביות כדי לראות בדיוק כמה OVR כל תקציב מקבל
► כל ה-OVR מחושבים ללא עליות דירוג ותגים - הערך האמיתי של כל רסיסי קוביות
► סגל 10,000 רסיסי קוביות: שחקני 116-117 OVR הזולים ביותר במשחק, שלושה במערך האחורי, פרין, קים מין ג'ה, גאטי, קופמיינרס וג'ונתן דיוויד
► סגל 50,000 רסיסי קוביות: מנואל נוייר, הארי קיין, רודריגו, ברקולה, אלפונסו דייויס, גוסטו, ברמר ואדר מיליטאו
► סגל 100,000 רסיסי קוביות: שצ'סני, מרסלו, סינגו, ברמר, יילידיז, פביאן רואיז ופירוט מלא של ההתקפה
► סגל 500,000 שרד: פטר צ'ך, פיליפ לאם, קייליני, טוני קרוס, פירלו, מקללה, גארת' בייל ורונאלדו
► אילו סגנונות משחק באמת חשובים - מהיר לעומת מאיץ, קדימון, שומר ומסיט הסבר

te.title: FC MOBILE లో 10,000 షార్డ్స్ vs 500,000 షార్డ్స్ స్క్వాడ్!
te.description:
📩 వ్యాపార విచారణలు: rkreddy@digitalsportsmgmt.com

ఈ వీడియోలో ఏముంది

► ప్రతి బడ్జెట్‌తో మీకు ఎంత OVR లభిస్తుందో ఖచ్చితంగా చూడటానికి, 10,000, 50,000, 100,000 మరియు 500,000 షార్డ్‌లతో 4 విభిన్న FC మొబైల్ స్క్వాడ్‌లను నిర్మించడం
► మొత్తం OVR ర్యాంక్ అప్‌లు మరియు బ్యాడ్జ్‌లు లేకుండా లెక్కించబడింది — ప్రతి షార్డ్ యొక్క నిజమైన విలువ

► 10,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్: గేమ్‌లోని అత్యంత చౌకైన 116-117 OVR ప్లేయర్‌లు, త్రీ ఎట్ ది బ్యాక్ ఫార్మేషన్, పెరిన్, కిమ్ మిన్ జే, గట్టి, కూప్‌మీనర్స్ మరియు జొనాథన్ డేవిడ్
► 50,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్: మాన్యుయెల్ న్యూయర్, హ్యారీ కేన్, రోడ్రిగో, బార్కోలా, అల్ఫోన్సో డేవిస్, గుస్టో, బ్రెమర్ మరియు ఎడెర్ మిలిటావో
► 100,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్: స్జెజ్నీ, మార్సెలో, సింగో, బ్రెమర్, యిల్డిజ్, ఫాబియన్ రూయిజ్ మరియు పూర్తి అటాక్ విశ్లేషణ
► 500,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్: పీటర్ చెక్, ఫిలిప్ లామ్, చియెల్లినీ, టోనీ క్రూస్, పిర్లో, మాకెలేలే, గారెత్ బేల్ మరియు రొనాల్డో
► ఏ ఆట శైలులు నిజంగా ముఖ్యమైనవి — రాపిడ్ వర్సెస్ యాక్సిలరేటర్, యాంటిసిపేట్, గార్డియన్ మరియు డిఫ్లెక్టర్ వివరణ
► ఎక్కడ ఎక్కువగా ఖర్చు చేయాలి మరియు ఎక్కడ ఆదా చేయాలి — గోల్ కీపర్ స్థానం మీ బడ్జెట్‌ను ఎందుకు తినేయకూడదు
► ప్రతి ఒక్క సైనింగ్‌కు ముందు పూర్తి స్టాట్ పోలికలు
► తుది ఫలితాలు: OVR 10K, 50K, 100K మరియు 500K షార్డ్‌లతో మీరు నిజంగా ఎంత పొందుతారు

అధ్యాయాలు

0:00 4 బడ్జెట్ ఛాలెంజ్ వివరణ
0:30 10,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్ నిర్మాణం

4:45 10,000 షార్డ్ ఫలితం

5:15 50,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్ నిర్మాణం
11:30 50,000 షార్డ్ ఫలితం
11:58 100,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్ నిర్మాణం
16:22 100,000 షార్డ్ ఫలితం

16:56 500,000 షార్డ్ స్క్వాడ్ నిర్మాణం
21:48 తుది ఫలితాలు — అన్ని 4 బడ్జెట్‌ల పోలిక

EA SPORTS FC మొబైల్‌లో సాధ్యమైనంత ఉత్తమమైన స్క్వాడ్‌లను నేను ఇక్కడే నిర్మిస్తాను — ప్రతి వారం బడ్జెట్ స్క్వాడ్ బిల్డర్లు, చౌకైన అద్భుతమైన ఎంపికలు, ప్యాక్ ఓపెనింగ్‌లు, అప్‌గ్రేడ్‌లు, ర్యాంక్ అప్ గైడ్‌లు మరియు నిజమైన గేమ్‌ప్లే. మీరు మీ షార్డ్‌లను ఖర్చు చేయడానికి ముందే ఏ ఆటగాళ్ళు వాటికి తగినవారో ఖచ్చితంగా తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటే, మీరు సరైన చోట ఉన్నారు. తదుపరి నేను ఏ బడ్జెట్‌తో స్క్వాడ్ నిర్మించాలో కామెంట్ చేయండి. సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ చేసి, బెల్ ఐకాన్‌ను నొక్కండి, తద్వారా మీరు ఏ వీడియోను మిస్ అవ్వరు.

నా ఇతర ఛానెల్స్

💸 F2P / బ్రోక్ FC సిరీస్: https://www.youtube.com/@RkReddy2.0

► 50,000 ਸ਼ਾਰਡ ਸਕੁਐਡ: ਮੈਨੂਅਲ ਨਿਊਅਰ, ਹੈਰੀ ਕੇਨ, ਰੋਡਰੀਗੋ, ਬਾਰਕੋਲਾ, ਅਲਫੋਂਸੋ ਡੇਵਿਸ, ਗੁਸਟੋ, ਬ੍ਰੇਮਰ ਅਤੇ ਏਡਰ ਮਿਲਿਟਾਓ
► 100,000 ਸ਼ਾਰਡ ਸਕੁਐਡ: ਸਜ਼ਚੇਸਨੀ, ਮਾਰਸੇਲੋ, ਸਿੰਗੋ, ਬ੍ਰੇਮਰ, ਯਿਲਡੀਜ਼, ਫੈਬੀਅਨ ਰੁਈਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮਲਾ ਟੁੱਟਣਾ
► 500,000 ਸ਼ਾਰਡ ਸਕੁਐਡ: ਪੇਟਰ ਚੇਚ, ਫਿਲਿਪ ਲਾਹਮ, ਚੀਏਲਿਨੀ, ਟੋਨੀ ਕ੍ਰੂਸ, ਪਿਰਲੋ, ਮੈਕੇਲੇਲੇ, ਗੈਰੇਥ ਬੇਲ ਅਤੇ ਰੋਨਾਲਡੋ
► ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਖੇਡ ਸ਼ੈਲੀਆਂ ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਇਨੇ ਰੱਖਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ - ਰੈਪਿਡ ਬਨਾਮ ਐਕਸਲੇਟਰ, ਐਂਪੀਸੀਟ, ਗਾਰਡੀਅਨ ਅਤੇ ਡਿਫਲੈਕਟਰ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ
► ਕਿੱਥੇ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਖਰਚ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਕਿੱਥੇ ਬਚਾਉਣਾ ਹੈ - ਗੋਲਕੀਪਰ ਸਲਾਟ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਬਜਟ ਕਿਉਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਖਾਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ
► ਹਰ ਇੱਕ ਸਾਈਨਿੰਗ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਟੇਟ ਤੁਲਨਾ
► ਅੰਤਿਮ ਨਤੀਜੇ: OVR 10K, 50K, 100K ਅਤੇ 500K ਸ਼ਾਰਡ ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ

ਇਹ ਉਹ ਥਾਂ ਹੈ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਮੈਂ EA SPORTS FC ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਸੰਭਵ ਸਕੁਐਡ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ — ਬਜਟ ਸਕੁਐਡ ਬਿਲਡਰ, ਸਸਤੇ ਜਾਨਵਰਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ, ਪੈਕ ਓਪਨਿੰਗ, ਅੱਪਗ੍ਰੇਡ, ਰੈਂਕ ਅੱਪ ਗਾਈਡ ਅਤੇ ਅਸਲ ਗੇਮਪਲੇ ਹਰ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ। ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਹ ਜਾਣਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸ਼ਾਰਡਸ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਹਨ, ਤਾਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਖਰਚਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਹੀ ਜਗ੍ਹਾ 'ਤੇ ਹੋ। ਟਿੱਪਣੀ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਅੱਗੇ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਬਜਟ ਬਣਾਉਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ। ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਾਈਬ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਘੰਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਦਬਾਓ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਵੀਡੀਓ ਨਾ ਗੁਆਓ।

snippet.title: I Had 3 Days To Get ESPORTS PRO Badge 😳
snippet.description:
I Had Only 3 Days To Get An ESPORTS PRO Badge… 😳

In this video, I challenged myself to become a Free Fire esports player in just 3 days. The goal was simple — compete in tournaments, improve my performance, qualify through different stages and finally try to earn the PRO Badge. 🏆

But the journey was MUCH harder than I expected…

🔥 DAY 1 — The tournament grind begins
⚔️ DAY 2 — Tougher matches & higher pressure
🏆 DAY 3 — The FINAL attempt to achieve the goal

I had to deal with strong players, intense matches, pressure, mistakes and limited time. Every match mattered because one bad game could end the entire challenge.

This isn't just a rank push — it's my attempt to step into the Free Fire esports scene and prove whether I actually have what it takes to become a PRO player.

🇮🇳 From a normal Free Fire player to chasing an esports PRO Badge… this is where the journey begins.


This is only the beginning… 👀

snippet.title: Eivan Thorne – The Night We Met
snippet.description:
#eivanthorne #rockballad #emotionalballad
Eivan Thorne – The Night We Met
Is a deeply emotional alternative rock ballad about the memory of a first meeting that remains unforgettable long after everything else has changed. This song captures the bittersweet feeling of remembering the exact moment when love first began.

At its heart, “The Night We Met” is about nostalgia, first love, memory, and the desire to return to a time before the ending was known. It explores that rare moment when two strangers meet and suddenly the world seems to disappear around them. Years may pass, people may change, and relationships may end, but some memories remain permanently connected to who we were when they happened.

The song looks back at a simple evening beneath a streetlight and transforms it into something much larger: a symbol of possibility, youth, innocence, and the beginning of a story that could have lasted forever. Rather than focusing only on heartbreak, it celebrates the beauty of what existed before regret and distance entered the picture.

snippet.title: Bu Kalp Sana Ait Artık ❤️ | Murat Yavuz | Kalbe Dokunan Şarkılar
snippet.description:
“Bu Kalp Sana Ait Artık”, insanın ömründe belki de yalnızca bir kez yaşayabileceği o derin sevgiyi anlatıyor…

Yıllarca aradığın insanı sonunda bulmak…
Geçmişte yaşadığın bütün acıların onun bir gülüşüyle anlamını yitirmesi…
Ve kalbinin artık başka hiç kimseye ait olamayacağını bilmek…

❤️ “Bu kalp sana ait artık
Senden başka sevemiyorum
Adını duymadan geçen günü
Ömürden saymıyorum…”

Bazı insanlar hayatımıza yalnızca girmez; kalbimize yerleşir. Zaman geçer, yıllar değişir ama o kalbin sahibi hiç değişmez.

🎵 Bu Kalp Sana Ait Artık
Söz – Müzik: Murat Yavuz
Kalbe Dokunan Şarkılar

en-US.title: This Heart Belongs to You Now ❤️ | Murat Yavuz | Songs That Touch the Heart
en-US.description:
“This Heart Belongs to You Now” tells the story of that deep love a person might only experience once in their lifetime…

Finding the person you’ve been searching for all these years…
All the pain you’ve experienced in the past losing its meaning with just one smile…
And knowing that your heart can no longer belong to anyone else…

❤️ “This heart belongs to you now
I can’t love anyone else but you
I don’t count a day that passes without hearing your name
As part of my life…”

Some people don’t just enter our lives; they settle in our hearts. Time passes, years change, but the owner of that heart never changes.

🎵 This Heart Belongs to You Now
Lyrics – Music: Murat Yavuz
Heart-Touching Songs

If you liked the song, don’t forget to like it, share your feelings in the comments, and subscribe to the Heart-Touching Songs channel. ❤️
